source: Local Codex usage records, bounded 32MiB tail; private conversation excluded.
association: Call-id matches request/output. Usage ordinals between them are chronological association, not a provider-attested foreign key. Before-output usage authors the request, cannot include its new result. First later usage may include the result in whole context; not isolated image/receipt/SDK cost.
limits: Fixed order guarded-local then direct-post; earlier full results remain in later context. Cache and context growth confound any arm token comparison.
Usage includes full primary conversation, model output and reasoning; counters do not measure only this interface.
Local context may be missing before first turn_context in the bounded tail; missing context stays null.
